'''Harp'r''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tahm]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. She wielded life-stealing [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magics]] and a double-bladed red [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in combat. In [[3642 BBY]], she fought alongside her master and fellow apprentice [[Mace (Sith apprentice)|Mace]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], and were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the [[Sundari Flatlands]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces.<ref name="Harp'r" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harp'r appears as "Apprentice Harp'r" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a Level 34 Elite enemy on the planet Balmorra, where she can be found along with Apprentice Mace and Sith Lord Tahm in the Sundari Flatlands region.<ref name="Harp'r" />
